import re

def main():
    s = input().strip()
    pattern = re.compile(r'(.)\1*')
    matches = pattern.finditer(s)
    result = 0
    first = True
    for m in matches:
        run = m.group()
        length = len(run)
        if first and run[0] == '.':
            if length % 2 == 1:
                result += 1
        elif length % 2 == 0:
            result += 1
        first = False
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
